description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of intestate in Kahengama, Kuruwita D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620283
categorisation: This gazette notice exclusively concerns land and property matters, specifically the calling for claims to intestate property (land) under the Registration of Title Act. It deals with land title registration, property ownership claims, and includes specific land details (cadastral map number, parcel number, extent of land). The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it primarily deals with land registration and property ownership matters.
